arguments.user_request: User reports the other pair of headphones also does not work and requests a refund for that pair.
arguments.facts_found: Verified U022 using registered email. Order O0049 belongs to U022, delivered 2026-09-11, paid by Card, shipping_fee ₹99. Two wireless headphone items I0051 and I0052, electronics, each ₹3,000. Today 2026-09-15 IST is day 4 after delivery, within the inclusive 7-day electronics return window. I0051 already received a completed ₹3,099 damaged-item refund on 2026-09-13, including shipping. The remaining pair is I0052; check_evidence confirms its photo is uploaded. New defective-item refund would be ₹3,000 to original Card with no pickup fee; shipping cannot be refunded again. Cumulative order refunds would be ₹3,099 + ₹3,000 = ₹6,099, exceeding ₹5,000. Refund history shows 1 qualifying refund in the last 90 days, so E10 does not trigger. No return created and no new refund issued.
arguments.rule_triggered: E9 and H2: cumulative refunds on an order, including previously refunded shipping, would exceed ₹5,000; escalation required. E13 applies damaged-item rules to the defective headphones. E12 prohibits refunding shipping twice. G3 relevant facts gathered before escalation.
arguments.what_user_was_told: The second pair on O0049 is within the return window and has the required photo. Its refund would be ₹3,000 to the original card, with shipping already included in the previous ₹3,099 refund. Total refunds would reach ₹6,099, above the agent's ₹5,000 authorization limit, so the request is being referred to a human support agent for review.
